questions.prompt: Match each tool to what it does.

pairs.right: Fixes problems that stop Windows from loading
Returns system files and settings to an earlier point
Checks and replaces damaged protected system files

questions.explanation: Choose the tool that matches the symptom, least destructive first.

questions.prompt: Which keyboard action opens the recovery environment from the Start menu?
choices: Hold Ctrl while clicking Shut down
questions.explanation: Shift + Restart opens Windows Recovery Environment.

questions.prompt: SFC reports it cannot repair some files. What should you run?
questions.explanation: DISM repairs the component store SFC uses to replace damaged files.

questions.prompt: Which Safe Mode option lets you download a driver?
questions.explanation: Only Safe Mode with Networking loads network drivers.

questions.prompt: "Reset this PC → Keep my files" will…
choices: Keep personal files but remove installed programs and settings
questions.explanation: Programs must be reinstalled afterwards. Back up first anyway.
